worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.summary: Compress pure rage into a crimson dragon shell and slam it home: the blow is never compared against attack or defence, so it always tears away a fixed 40 HP no matter how tough the target is (only a type immunity stops it), shoving it back and pinning it briefly. The eruption form instead detonates at the target point over an area.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.use.0: Use fixed damage against a high-defence target
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.use.1: Shove a charging foe back and pin it
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.use.2: Eruption form: strip a whole cluster at once
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.description: Whatever the target's defence and typing, a hit always removes %1$s HP; only a type immunity stops it.
The rage reaches %1$s blocks and flies at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; it settles on the first enemy it strikes.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.erupt.on: Eruption form: it detonates over %2$s blocks on arrival; up to %4$s foes each take %1$s fixed damage and are shoved %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.erupt.off: Ram form: the target is shoved %1$s blocks and rooted for %2$s seconds — it cannot move, but can still attack.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.growth.0: From level %1$s the range rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonrage.growth.1: From level %1$s the range rises to %2$s blocks and the pin lasts %3$s seconds.
On: the shell detonates at the target point; up to 5 foes within take the fixed 40 and are shoved outward, but the range is shorter, the cooldown longer and nobody is rooted. Off (ram form, default): single target, a straighter shove, and the target is briefly rooted, unable to move.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from further away.
On: prefer it to finish a target already below half health (fixed damage ignores defence). Off: only the threat itself counts.
